The results shows that the evaporation duct can trap part of the electromagnetic power to achieve long-distance transmission.

articleTitle: Parallelization design of WELL19937 based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This study aims to achieve efficient parallel processing of WELL19937(1024,32) on Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) platforms by applying a hybrid parallelization strategy. The goal is to enhance system clock frequency and data processing throughput while optimizing hardware resource utilization and reducing circuit area requirements. The improved Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG) can provide security assurance for dynamic encryption scenarios. Furthermore, this paper rigorously evaluates the statistical performance of both serial and parallel random number sequences generated by the PRNG, verifying the randomness of the system. Additionally, the parallel system outperforms related works on other platforms in terms of data output and operating frequency.

articleTitle: Microwave Polarization Detection System Based on Spoof Localized Surface Plasmons
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Polarization, a fundamental characteristic of electromagnetic (EM) waves, is crucial for modern communication and remote sensing systems. High-precision acquisition of polarization information is essential in sensing applications for accurately identifying and analyzing targets and scenes. This paper introduces a novel method for detecting microwave polarization using spoof localized surface plasmons (SLSPs). SLSPs are EM modes that simulate electronic and optical resonance phenomena in the microwave and terahertz bands, exhibiting deep subwavelength characteristics, field confinement, and near-field enhancement. These attributes enable device miniaturization and improved signal-to-noise ratios. The proposed method involves decomposing the dipole eigenmodes of the SLSPs into two orthogonal basis modes. By measuring their responses, accurate polarization information of incident microwaves can be obtained. A practical polarization sensing device consisting of an SLSPs resonator, was designed and validated through simulations and experiments. Additionally, we explored integrating the polarization sensing system with a circuit system. This paper offers a promising approach for advanced applications in microwave polarization detection.

articleTitle: Dual Bandpass Tunable Frequency Selective Surface Design
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a dual-bandpass tunable frequency selective surface (FSS) designed based on an active FSS. The dual-bandpass is achieved by employing two different sizes of aperture-periodic structures. The bandpass tunability of the FSS is realised by employing a loaded varactor diode. In addition, the FSS is capable of achieving polarization and angle stabilization characteristics through the adoption of a symmetric and simplified feeder network design, while simultaneously reducing the insertion loss effect of the bandpass brought about by the feeder. The results of the simulation calculations demonstrate that this design is capable of realizing the dual-band bandpass tunable characteristics in C, X, and Ku band.

articleTitle: A Low-loss X-band Frequency-Selective Rasorber
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a wideband and low insertion loss frequency-selective Rasorber (FSR). The proposed FSR structure consists of windmill-shaped resistive absorbers and double-layer square-ring frequency selective surfaces. The absorber layer incorporates a U-shaped metal structure that acts as an LC parallel resonator, achieving wideband electromagnetic wave transmission. Simulation results show that this FSR design has -1 dB insertion loss from 8.0 to 12.2 GHz, with a minimum of -0.4 dB. A wideband FSR was fabricated and measured to validate the design.

articleTitle: Optimizing Antenna Design through AI Integration: A Concise Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence with antenna design and optimization represents a promising research frontier. This paper provides a concise overview of current research, emphasizing the computational cost challenges associated with implementing machine learning in antenna design and optimization. It explores the advantages and limitations of utilizing the Kriging model and the Surrogate-assisted Differential Evolution Algorithm (SADEA) series to tackle these cost constraints.

articleTitle: Low Side-lobe High-Mode OAM Beam Generation Technique Based on Concentric Ring Array
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The electromagnetic waves carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) have attracted extensive research attention due to their helical phase front, which can be used to obtain more information in the detection. However, OAM beams generated by uniform circular array (UCA) suffer from the high side-lobe, which lower the anti-interference ability. In this paper, a multi-loop uniform concentric circular array (UCCA) is proposed to generate low side-lobe, high-mode OAM beams. A low side-lobe 7-mode OAM beam is obtained assisted by the phase modulation. The UCCA is fabricated and tested. The measured results show that the side-lobe levels of ±7-mode OAM beams generated by the UCCA are all below -12.79 dB within the operating frequency range (9.7 GHz - 10.3 GHz).

articleTitle: A Network Security Management System Structure Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The aim of the article is to study the network security architecture. And it is designed to meet the security management. The composition of the structure network security is proposed. The router nodes are developed that have strong versatility and flexible structures. Internet of things may monitor the reliably. So a multi-layer architecture is proposed. It is showed that a proposed multi-layer security architecture is safe and effective.

articleTitle: A Novel Broadband Low Profile Circularly Polarized Antenna Using AMC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this study, a novel broadband low profile circularly polarized antenna using artificial magnetic conductor (AMC) is proposed. The antenna loads a 7×7 AMC array below the traditional square slot circularly polarized antenna, which achieves forward radiation of circularly polarized and wider impedance and axial ratio (AR) bandwidths. The AMC structure achieves an in-phase reflection bandwidth of 26.3% (3.77-4.91 GHz). According to the simulation results of the antenna in HFSS, an impedance bandwidth of the proposed antenna is 47% (3.05-4.92GHz), and a 3-dB axial ratio (AR) bandwidth is 15.7% (4.34-5.08GHz). The peak gain within the circularly polarized working frequency band is 7.9dBi. The overall effect of the antenna using AMC is significantly better than not using AMC.

articleTitle: Wide Solid Angle Scanning Conical Conformal Phased Array Antenna Based on Bidirectional Beam
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a conical conformal antenna array with wide solid angle scanning range. The proposed antenna array employs two columns of conformal patch subarrays symmetrically distributed on the surface of a conical structure. With the symmetric structure, the antenna array can generate bidirectional beam to cover two symmetric azimuth sectors simultaneously. Given different phase distributions to the subarrays, the generated bidirectional beam exhibits different elevation angles, thus realizing scanning of the bidirectional beam with respect to the conical structure. Excited with four sets of phase difference, the proposed antenna array covers elevation range of -90° to -42° and 42° to 90° with 3dB beamwidth in azimuth plane of 138° to 170°. The conical conformal antenna array realizes wide solid angle scanning range with a simple structure, it is suitable for military detection and civil surveillance applications.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Digital Coding Metasurface Based on VO2 for Independent Control of Spatial and Surface Waves
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Recently, the digital coding metasurface has garnered widespread attention. In this paper, integrating the concept of hybrid digital coding metasurfaces with VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> thin films allows for the independent manipulation of spatial waves and surface waves. By harnessing the phase transition properties of vanadium dioxide (VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>), one can dynamically alternate between reflection phase encoding and surface impedance encoding in the metasurface.The functional characteristics of this metasurface have been validated through simulations, showcasing significant potential applications in novel radar and satellite communication systems.

articleTitle: Terahertz Full-Space Metasurface with Independent Amplitude-Phase Control based on FSS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this work, we propose a method to independently manipulate the phase and amplitude of terahertz wave based on the full-space assisted by FSS. The full-space metasurface (FSMS) of the AFA architecture (A, upper resonant structure, F, intermediate FSS, A, (lower resonant structure) is designed by introducing the FSS, which can indirectly modulate the transmission and reflection amplitude by adjusting the operating frequency of the intermediate FSS, to allocate the energy of the modulated wave in the full space. In the meantime, excellent independence between phase control based on PB theory and amplitude modulation assisted by FSS is proved. This work will develop the modulation potential of the hypersurface and apply it to future terahertz technologies for miniaturization and multifunctionality.

articleTitle: Design of Microstrip Antennas Based on Characteristic Mode Analysis Using Free-form Deformation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper aims to explore a novel method for designing microstrip antennas based on free-form deformation (FFD) and characteristic mode analysis (CMA). The microstrip antenna model is adjusted and optimized by utilizing the FFD from computer graphics. The study analyzes adjusting and optimizing the microstrip antenna model under the FFD algorithm. The design of the microstrip antenna is transformed into a basic shape with coordinates of several adjustable control points, allowing for iterative optimization through the free adjustment of these control points. For the Ku-band antenna model, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is employed to create an optimized description model for a rectangular microstrip antenna, adjusting its characteristic modes to exhibit a single mode within the design frequency range. The computational results demonstrate that resonance at multiple frequency points within the Ku-band can be achieved. This confirms that the combined algorithm of FFD and CMA is effective in addressing microstrip antenna design challenges.

articleTitle: All-Metal Metamaterial Based Leaky Wave Antenna with High Power Capacity and Fixed Frequency Beam Scanning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: An all-metal metamaterial based leaky wave antenna (LWA) array with fixed-frequency beam scanning and high power capacity is presented in this research. The beam scanning mechanism is by tuning the length of shorted stub and changing the equivalent dielectric constant and permeability of the metamaterial element. Thus the phase constant of the -1th spatial harmonic wave can be modified and continuous beam scanning can be realized. A 81 LWA array is manufactured, simulation and measurement results show that a nearly 20 beam scanning range can be achieved at the central frequency 10 GHz. The proposed LWA array is suitable for low cost beam scanning antenna with high power capacity.

articleTitle: Research of Sampling Method For Cybercrime Black Industry Chain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In modern organization theories, the social network established by cyber criminals is termed the crime cyber black industry chain. Under the current technical level, treating a crime cyber black industry chain as a whole dataset has to face severe challenges in many aspects, so the research of the sampling method specifically for it has been one of the current hot topics. Based on the structural feature of a cybercrime industry chain, the overall framework and the detailed algorithm of a multi-stage sampling method are proposed. Tested with real cybercrime datasets, our proposed multi-stage sampling method outperforms existing mainstream single-stage sampling methods at macro, meso, and micro scales, indicating it can solve practical problems with high efficiency and low cost.

articleTitle: A RFID Chipless Tag Based on Hybrid Frequency-Polarization Coding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, the method of hybrid frequency-polarization coding is proposed for chipless tag coding. The encoding is achieved by the change of polarization angle and frequency shift coding technology. The structure consists of two CSRRs and three angular-orientation structures with no dielectric substrate. The angular-orientation structure is used to recognize the polarization angle. The results show that the hybrid frequency-polarization coding can reach 9216 coded IDs, which is 36 times more than the number of IDs reached by the single frequency coding.

articleTitle: Discuss the digital twin technology of substation based on ARM system
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The development of smart substations has significantly improved the stability, reliability, and economy of the power system. It helps to realize the monitoring of the new power system, realize the high-quality development of the power grid, reduce the cost of operation and maintenance, and provide technical support for the access and consumption of new energy. With the continuous development of society, the smart substation will play a key role in the new power system.

articleTitle: A novel tightly coupled dual-polarized crossed dipole array antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A novel tightly coupled dual polarized crossed dipole triangular array antenna is designed in this paper. To satisfy certain system requirements, the antenna plane mentioned in this paper has a 2D dimension of 23:13 and is designed only for the frequency range of 8-9 GHz. The printed crossed dipole patch is used as the radiating unit of the antenna, and the matching performance of the antenna unit is effectively improved by a series of measures such as using a balanced balun feed structure for each port and adding parasitic patches above the dipole. To further improve the active VSWR of the antenna unit, resistive branches are loaded at both ends of each dielectric plate. Simulation results show that the 8*8 tightly-coupled triangular phased array composed of this unit (with a spacing of 0) has an active VSWR of less than 2.5 in the frequency range of 8-9 GHz, and is also capable of achieving E-plane, H-plane, and D-plane beam sweeps of ±45° in this frequency range.

articleTitle: Enhancing Precision Agriculture: YOLOv8 for Accurate Corn Disease and Pest Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Corn is a crucial staple crop globally, with its production facing challenges due to the prevalence of pests and diseases. This paper presents the use of YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once version 8) algorithm, an advanced object detection technology, to identify and classify corn diseases such as gray leaf spot and southern rust. With deep convolutional networks, batch normalization layers, and attention mechanisms, YOLOv8 offers high accuracy and real-time processing even in complex environments. Experimental results show an 80.44% accuracy in disease detection, reducing false negatives and positives, thereby enhancing agricultural control efficiency and crop yield. Moreover, YOLOv8 facilitates precision agriculture, leading to reduced pesticide use, lower production costs, and less environmental impact. The paper also explores potential applications of YOLOv8 in pest and disease detection across various crops and proposes future research directions for model adaptive learning and integration with smart agricultural systems. Through technical descriptions and real-world application analyses, this study offers insights for smart agricultural technologies and future research in this field.

articleTitle: Research on Low-Power FPGA Accelerator for Radar Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning technology, object detection models have shown great potential in various applications. However, the high computational requirements of this type of model have become a bottleneck for its widespread adoption on resource-constrained, energy-efficiency-first devices. The flexibility of FPGA allows for the deployment of the YOLO model on various hardware platforms, including embedded systems and edge devices. In summary, deploying the YOLO model on FPGA can achieve real-time, low-power object detection, providing efficient visual perception capabilities for various application scenarios. This paper is based on the YOLOv2 radar detection algorithm and utilizes hardware FPGA acceleration for target detection. The system has been verified to provide target detection with low power consumption. Compared to the CPU (i7-6700k), While maintaining as much accuracy as possible in detection, it saves about 23 times in terms of power consumption.

articleTitle: A time allocation-based user position monitoring for satellite networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite, as a powerful supplement to ground devices, has attracted widespread attention and research owing to its wide coverage, ubiquitous access, and affluent resources. Due to the high dynamic characteristics of LEO, LEO has limited service for users and requires frequent beam handover, making poor user service continuity an extremely challenging problem. To solve the link interruption problem caused by frequent beam handover, the research on satellite Internet of Things (SIoT) becomes very meaningful. Therefore, we propose a time slot allocation mechanism based on user position monitoring. The mechanism designs different resource reservation methods for new calls and handover calls. The simulation indicates that our proposed mechanism reduces signaling overhead and ensures service continuity.

articleTitle: A Transmit-Reflect Array Antenna Based on Spin-decoupled Metasurface Generating Multibeam Carrying Orbital Angular Momentum Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a single-layer transmit-reflect metasurface is designed based on a spin-decoupled strategy. Under different circular polarized wave incidences, two Bessel beams can be generated simultaneously in the +z and -z directions at 8 GHz simultaneously. The meta-atom is intricately optimized with two split rings and a square ring located at the edge. Simulated results demonstrate a spiral phase distribution and ring-like amplitude profiles with a cavity in the middle, matching the classic characteristics of orbital angular momentum (OAM). The results show that the proposed metasurface is capable of flexibly manipulating electromagnetic waves, making it applicable in wireless communication and high-resolution imaging.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Channel Simulator for Complex Enclosed Space
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In order to evaluate the performance of wireless communication systems in a faster and more economic fashion, we propose to design the so-called channel simulator, through which wireless channel properties of complex enclosed environments are reconstructed by a simple device. In this sense, channel measurements in specific scenarios, e.g. aircrafts, which are formerly expensive and time-consuming become concise and cost-effective. This paper introduces the concept of channel simulator and describes the design process in detail. Simulated results of wireless channel properties from the simulator are compared with those from a realistic aircraft model, verifying the feasibility and potential of the idea.

articleTitle: D-plane Cross-polarization Suppression of Microstrip Patch Antennas
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A new method to reduce the D-plane cross-polarization of microstrip patch antennas (MPA) is proposed. Firstly, the E-plane, D-plane and H-plane cross-polarization performance is discussed when the antenna is operated in TM10 mode. Here, the D-plane represents the diagonal plane of the MPA. Secondly, the study focuses deeply on improving the H-plane cross-polarization by incorporating notches of various shapes, including square, rectangular, and triangular ones, into the ground plane. This approach aims to mitigate undesired polarization effects. Thirdly, the effect of notches of different sizes on the cross-polarization of different planes is discussed. Finally, the simulated results demonstrate that the utilization of square and triangular notches in the ground plane can effectively improve the D-plane cross-polarization by 1.4 dB and 4.6 dB within a beamwidth of 100 degrees, respectively. This significant enhancement in polarization performance suggests that our proposed method holds promising potential for applications requiring high polarization purity.

articleTitle: Error Compensation based Approximate Booth Multiplier with Improved Booth Encoder and Low Complexity Compressor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Approximate multipliers reduce energy consumption in image processing by simplifying circuits, thereby introducing output errors. In this paper, three approximate Booth multipliers, including CABM1(Configurable Approximate Booth Multiplier 1), CABM2, and CABM3, are proposed by designing a booth encoder based on the value replacement of the Karnaugh map to reduce gate count. Then, new approximate compressors are presented for CABM2 to compensate for errors produced by the proposed booth encoder. Next, based on CABM2, the required resources of CABM3 are further reduced by introducing an OR gate. The output approximation of proposed multipliers is adjustable by configuring the number of applied approximate encoders. The exhaustive simulation and FPGA hardware implementation results show that compared with previous multipliers, CABM1 achieves a 41.7% reduction in MaxED (maximum error distance). Also, the NMED (Normalized mean error distance) for CABM2 decreases by 51.8%. Additionally, CABM3 reduces 51.1% NMED. Finally, the image multiplication results show that the PSNR reaches around 32dB, 2dB higher than previous designs; with SSIM remaining above 98%.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Networks for Estimating DOA of Multiple Radio Waves
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This letter proposes a deep neural network (DNN)-based direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation approach. Novel DOA selection methods, threshold selection and peak selection, are utilized to select the DOA from the DNN outputs. Unlike conventional methods that require prior knowledge of the number of incoming waves, the proposed network architecture offers a more flexible approach to tracking and positioning without knowing the number of incoming waves in advance. Moreover, an amendment to reduce output near the peak point is proposed to reduce DOA estimation errors. The flexibility opens up new possibilities and has demonstrated high DOA estimation accuracy for multiple incident waves.

Index Terms: Output Of The Deep Neural Network

articleTitle: A Low-Profile Wideband Circularly Polarized Metasurface-based Filtering Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a low-profile wideband circularly polarized (CP) filtering antenna with metasurface is designed without an additional filtering network. The antenna has a 4×4 array of metallic patch cells, a ground with slots, a shorting via and a microstrip feedline. It fed by two separated slots located at the ground plane. A shorting metal via is utilized to provide a radiation null on the left side of the passband. The microstrip arm and the symmetrical open-loop resonator loaded near the microstrip feedline provide two radiation nulls on the right side of the passband. CP is achieved by chamfer of patch cells. According to simulation results, the proposed antenna may provide 26.34% (4.14-5.40 GHz) impedance bandwidth (IBW), 18.2% (4.48-5.37 GHz) axial ratio (AR) bandwidth, and 8.27dB realized gain.

articleTitle: A Cylindrical Dielectric Resonator Antenna With Differential Beam
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a dielectric resonator antenna with differential beam is proposed and investigated. It consists of a 1 × 2 cylindrical dielectric resonator antenna array (CDRA). The feed network consists of a 1-2 splitter and two probes. The side-coupling is used to excite the radiation elements, which is a simple feeding method and wideband impedance matching. The power is split into two paths by splitter, which ultimately results in a differential beam antenna. The -10 dB impedance bandwidth is 2.17-2.46 GHz, and the antenna can be used in the ISM band at 2.4 GHz and radar detection etc.

articleTitle: Design of a Forked Eander Slot Antenna Suitable for LTE 5G Frequency Band
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, an improved design of a miniaturized, broadband, meander fork-shaped microstrip antenna (MFSMA) with a radiating patch is proposed. By folding the elongated patch, the bandwidth is widened, while also solving the problem of increased board size and higher manufacturing costs caused by an overly long patch. Adding the asymmetric patch to the ground plane causes the lower edge of the bandwidth to decrease. Utilizing the above characteristics, a miniaturized antenna model was designed. The measurement results of this antenna show acceptable radiation characteristics, with a bandwidth of 1.31 GHz - 3.74 GHz (96.24%) in the condition of VSWR < 2. With its low cost, wide bandwidth, and high gain characteristics, it is well-suited for the LTE/5G applications.

articleTitle: Modeling of Resonant Radiation in Rod-like Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper conducts an in-depth study on the resonant radiation mechanism and radiation characteristics of rod-like structures, aiming to reveal the formation mechanism of resonant radiation. This research not only provides a solid physical foundation for radar target recognition but also offers guidance for understanding and applying the pole characteristics of complex targets. Through detailed analysis and calculation of the electromagnetic radiation process of rod-like structures, a mathematical model of electromagnetic radiation is established, and resonance conditions are derived based on the principles of resonant radiation. The study first focuses on the 'propagation-reflection-radiation' process of the current on the rod-like structure, elucidating how this process forms resonant radiation, and thus establishes the resonance equation. Finally, the paper quantitatively analyzes the late-time response mechanism of the rod-like structure, confirming the feasibility of the radiation field calculation method based on this mechanism. Consequently, the modeling and validation of the resonant radiation field are carried out.

articleTitle: The optimal design of cavity optomechanical micro-hemispherical gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Micro-hemispherical resonator gyroscope (micro-HRG) is one of the most precise micro-vibratory gyroscopes. However, traditional micro-hemispherical resonator gyroscope has complex processing and weak anti-electromagnetic ability. Micro-HRGs based on optomechanical drive the resonator cavity and detect angular velocity/vibrations through optomechanical interactions, offering advantages such as ultra-high precision and ease of control. This paper investigates the driving and detection mechanisms of angular velocity and vibrations in micro-HRGs based on cavity optomechanics and Whispering Gallery Mode (WGM), as well as their structural design methods. It includes simulation analyses of performance in optical modes and mechanical modes. In terms of optical modes, the paper discusses and analyzes the influence of the length and thickness of the outer edge of the resonator on the optical resonance frequency and the optical quality factor; in terms of mechanical modes, it discusses and analyzes the influence of the radius and length of the support column on the mechanical resonance frequency.

articleTitle: Characterizing the Mutual Terrain Scattered Interference in Spaceborne SAR Images under Different Terrains
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Mutual terrain scattered interference (MTSI) has been reported as an emerging threat due to the proliferation of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite constellations. It occurs due to the time, frequency, and space overlapping between adjacent satellites, which generates obvious artifacts in SAR images. One of the critical impacting factors is the process of signal scattering via different terrains. In this paper, the impact of different terrains on the appearance of artifacts is characterized. First, the model of MTSI scenario is established, and the echo signal model is derived. Then, it investigates the MTSI in spaceborne SAR images under different terrains like mountain, urban, desert, and sea through simulated experiments. The experiments show that different terrains would produce various artifact patterns.

articleTitle: Kernel Affine Projection Algorithms Based on the Robust Mixed-norm Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The kernel affine projection algorithm (KAPA) has been successfully applied in the context of time-series prediction. However, the KAPA’s filtering performance can be greatly affected by non-Gaussian noise. The mixed-norm algorithm (MNA) and generalized correntropy (GC) can still achieve fast convergence speed under non-Gaussian noise. In this paper, the combination of the KAPA, MNA and GC yields the kernel affine projection robust MNA (KAPRMNA). In order to further modify the convergence rate of the KAPRMNA, applying a variable-step-size (VSS) way to the KAPRMNA yields a new VSS-KAPRMNA. In the context of time-series prediction, simulations verify that both the KAPRMNA and VSS-KAPRMNA outperform some other known kernel AP-type algorithms with respect to the convergence rate in a-stable distribution environment.

articleTitle: Design of A High Gain, Compact Patch Antenna with a Tilted Radiation Pattern
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a compact, high-gain patch antenna with tilted radiation patterns. Due to the mixed couplings excited between the radiating patch with parasitic resonators in proximity, the tilted boresight radiation pattern is attained without introducing large parasitic elements (around 15~30 degrees). It is demonstrated that the proposed antenna holds a fractional bandwidth of 4.8% at a compact size of 0.483λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>×0.33λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>×0.048λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>. Moreover, higher than 7dBi realized gain values are obtained over the frequency band. The proposed antenna can be further applied in various applications, e.g., base station and airborne systems.

articleTitle: Radiation Pattern Computation with the Variable Resolution for Reflector Antennas using the CZT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) is widely used in antenna near-far field transformation. When FFT is applied in analyzing signal frequency bands that cannot be densely sampled, the frequency resolution obtained will be relatively low. Applying the Chirp-Z Transform (CZT) to the near-far field transformation highlights the characteristic of the CZT that allows the input points to be equally angle-sampled and then resampled. This expands the sampling quantity to any integer length. By using CZT, the antenna measurement points can be sampled and transformed into an arbitrary number of frequency points. This approach can change the resolution of sample points in the near-far field transformation, allowing for frequency spectrum refinement in specific narrow frequency bands.

articleTitle: A Broadband High Gain Base Station Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper suggests a base-station antenna unit designed for 2G/3G/LTE frequencies, featuring ±45° polarization, high gain, and low cross-polarization. The antenna is excited by two circular arc probes and uses two orthogonal rectangular ring dipoles to achieve a wider bandwidth. In order to achieve higher gain and better cross-polarization level, four parasitic elements are added around the dual dipole. The simulation results show that |S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>|<10 dB in 1.7-3.0 GHz(55.3%). Moreover, the antenna obtains better port isolation (>27 dB), higher gain (9.6±1.4 dBi), front-to-back ratio(>18 dB) and a beamwidth of 57.5±7.5° in the desired bandwidth range. The antenna can be used in the broadband base station of the communication system.

articleTitle: Literature Review on Age-Friendly Design of Urban Rail Transit wayfinding Signage in the Context of Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: As urban rail transit systems become increasingly significant in the daily mobility of city dwellers, the universal design of wayfinding signage emerges as a critical element in enhancing accessibility for ageing populations. With the advent of the digital economy, new opportunities and challenges arise in the integration of technology with conventional wayfinding strategies to serve the diverse needs of older adults. This literature review comprehensively examines existing research on the subject of age-friendly design for urban rail transit wayfinding signage. It highlights key principles and practices that align with the needs of aged users, considers the impact of digital advancements on these systems, and assesses how technology can facilitate better spatial orientation and navigation for the elderly. This paper aims to contribute to the discourse on creating more inclusive urban transit networks that align with the goals of the digital economy, benefiting not only older adults but the entire urban population.

articleTitle: Research on Signal Denoising Method Based on Symplectic Geometric Mode Decomposition and Savitzky-Golay Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The paper proposes a noise reduction algorithm based on symplectic Geometric Mode Decomposition (SGMD) and Savitzky-Golay (SG)filtering to address the issue of noise interference during signal transmission. Firstly, the noisy signal is decomposed using symplectic geometric mode decomposition to obtain several symplectic geometric components. The component with less noise is then selected and superimposed based on its energy entropy. Finally, the reconstructed signal undergoes denoising through SG filtering. The proposed method is applied to conduct comparison experiments on noise reduction for linear frequency modulation signals and multicomponent periodic signals. The results demonstrate a significant noise reduction effect of the proposed method, which holds great significance for signal analysis and research on noise reduction.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of a Low-Noise Mixer Using Advanced Design System (ADS) for RF Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In RF circuits, the mixer is an important component of the front-end circuit to achieve frequency conversion. A mixer design method for improving noise figure and conversion gain was proposed, which utilizes differential pairs to achieve signal processing. It mainly consists of bipolar transistors, local oscillator drive circuits, RF drive circuits, etc. Using ADS software to complete circuit design and simulation, the simulation results show that the improved mixer has significant advantages in suppressing noise and interference, and increasing conversion gain.

articleTitle: Joint beam placement and pattern design for beam-hopping HTS system
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Beam-hopping technology has become the focus of research in the field of high throughput satellite(HTS) communications because of its flexibility of resource allocation. When facing the uneven distribution of user positions, the quality of service of the existing resource allocation algorithms of beam-hopping systems is limited, because these algorithms either easily fall into sub-optimal solutions or cannot give a good resource allocation plan promptly. In this article, we use an extended minimum circle coverage(eMCC) algorithm to perform beamplacement, in order that the number of the beam positions can be decreased, leading to a low queueing delay. After this, due to the hidden markov property of the beam-hopping decision, we use the Viterbi algorithm to perform the beam hopping pattern. Through utilizing the independence between optional illumination pattern and adopting dynamic programming strategy, the computational complexity is reduced and the queueing delay of the system is ensured ulteriorly. Finally, by simulating and analysis, the resource allocation strategy of the joint beam position design proposed in this article can improve the throughput of the communication system while reducing the time complexity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Compact Wideband SIW Horn Antenna for Applications in X and Ku Bands
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a compact wideband horn antenna design suitable for the X-band and Ku-band is proposed. Firstly, by introducing a double-sided offset parallel-strip line (DSPSL) structure onto the extended substrate of the substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) horn antenna, the low-frequency impedance characteristics are adjusted, significantly broadening the antenna’s operating frequency range. Secondly, by sequentially loading interdigitated structures at the horn aperture and periodically arranging metal vias inside the waveguide, the antenna’s input reactance at mid-to-high frequencies is gradually optimized, significantly enhancing the antenna’s matching performance. Finally, to adjust the antenna’s matching and radiation performance in the low-frequency band, an improved transition structure is introduced onto the antenna’s dielectric cladding. Ultimately, while maintaining a compact size of 1.35λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>×0.77λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>×0.16λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> (λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> is the free space wavelength at the center frequency), the proposed antenna achieves a relative bandwidth of up to 75.14%, stable end-fire radiation performance, and moderate gain. These characteristics make it an ideal choice for conformal integration on small aircraft.

articleTitle: A SPICE-Compatible Model for On-Chip Coplanar Coupled Waveguides Up to 110 GHz
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A scalable and SPICE-compatible wideband model of on-chip coupled coplanar waveguides line up to 110 GHz is proposed in this paper. Based on the ideal circuit model derived from the multi-conductor transmission lines theory, the frequency-dependent RLGC parameters are synthesized using frequency-independent integrated components. The innovative adjustment of the mutual inductance in the model improves the model accuracy significantly. In addition, the scalability of the model is investigated using neural networks. For on-chip coupled coplanar waveguides line fabricated using a commercial 40 nm CMOS process, the model accuracy is verified through full-wave electromagnetic simulations in the frequency range up to 110 GHz. The proposed model is expected to accelerate the design and optimization of millimeter-wave circuits and systems.

articleTitle: A Non-contact Choke Structure for Broadside Adjustable Waveguide Phase Shifter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Broadside adjustable waveguide phase shifters (BAWPS) are widely used for phase adjustment of high-power microwaves (HPM) due to their simple structure and high power tolerance. However, due to the internal slot structure, it is inevitable to have electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) problems, which is a serious safety hazard in HPM applications. In this paper, a non-contact choke structure is designed by combining the structure and operation mechanism of BAWPS. By loading L-shaped choke slots on the metal isolation plate, it can satisfy the mechanical transmission and have good microwave suppression capability, which can effectively avoid electromagnetic crosstalk. In addition, the thickness of the isolation plate is effectively reduced by adding dielectric shims. Simulation results show that the BAWPS loaded with the designed non-contact choke structure is able to suppress the return loss below -20 dB and the insertion loss within 0.05 dB over the 360° phase shift. The energy leakage through the aperture is less than -90 dB, which has significant microwave protection effect.

articleTitle: Sea Clutter Simulation Using Condition Wasserstein Divergence Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To address the limitations of traditional methods and enable the generation of sea clutter controlled by scene conditions, we developed a Condition Wasserstein divergence Generative Adversarial Network (CWGAN-div) model and constructed a dataset comprising scene conditions and sea clutter data. The trained model can generate corresponding sea clutter in an end-to-end manner based on input scene conditions. In experiments, CWGAN-div demonstrates better tail probability density function (PDF) matching with empirical data. Furthermore, goodness-of-fit (GoF) tests show that CWGAN-div achieves the smallest Kolmogorov-Smirnov distances (KSD) under most conditions. This indicates that CWGAN-div effectively captures the non-Gaussian characteristics of sea clutter, providing improved fit quality and offering a novel approach for practical applications in sea clutter simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Gas Pipeline Fire Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The improved gas pipeline fire detection algorithm based on YOLOv8n plays a crucial role in the safety monitoring and fire warning system of gas pipelines, enhancing the detection rate and response speed of fire, effectively reducing human and financial losses caused by fire. This study established a dataset of fire images, incorporated the BiFPN network into YOLOv8n, and introduced the Focal DIoU Loss for bounding box regression calculation. Compared to the unimproved YOLOv8n, this algorithm has achieved an increase in Precision by 0.16%, Recall rate by 3.36%, and mAP@0.5 by 1.36%.

articleTitle: Enhanced Symplectic Geometric Mode Decomposition via K-means Clustering for LFM Signal Denoising
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This article presents a Symplectic Geometric Mode Decomposition (SGMD) method incorporating K-means clustering, coupled with wavelet denoising, for mitigating noise in Linear Frequency Modulation (LFM) signals. This method substitutes the original component recombination approach in SGMD with the K-means clustering algorithm, thus rendering the signal grouping more logically coherent. In the experiment, we compare the method proposed in this article with other denoising methods. The experimental findings demonstrate substantial advantages of the proposed method in mitigating noise in LFM signals, thereby enhancing both Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and signal quality. The research outcomes underscore the feasibility and substantial potential of this method in mitigating noise in signals. In subsequent studies, additional investigation into its applicability across diverse domains can be pursued alongside the refinement of clustering and denoising algorithms.

articleTitle: Sparsity-aware Subband Adaptive Filtering in Impulsive Interferences
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose two new subband adaptive filtering (SAF) algorithms based on the cost function of the logistic distance metric cost function and use the proportionate proximal gradient algorithm to exploit the sparsity of the system fully. Compared with prior works, the proposed algorithms can handle many different situations better. Through computer simulations, we prove that the algorithm performs excellently in sparse systems disturbed by impulse noises. The algorithm can be used in areas like system identifications.

articleTitle: A Novel Signal Denoising Method Based on Adaptive Stochastic Resonance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In non-cooperative communication, most of the received signals have low signal-to-noise ratio and less prior information. Therefore, before subsequent processing, the received signal should be effectively denoised. Denoising methods such as wavelet denoising and time-frequency transform have the problem of reducing noise and signal energy at the same time. Aiming at this problem, a large parameter variable scale adaptive tri-stable stochastic resonance (SR) method is proposed to denoise the multi-phase shift keying and multi-orthogonal amplitude modulation signals. On the basis of studying the traditional SR, the secondary sampling expansion frequency is adopted, and the fitness function based on singular value decomposition is used as the evaluation standard. The parameters of the tristable SR system are optimized by particle swarm optimization algorithm. The simulation results show that in the Gaussian channel environment, compared with the bi-stable adaptive SR method, this method can improve the output peak value and reduce the noise threshold to a certain extent, which is suitable for the enhancement of communication signals.

articleTitle: A Dual-polarized Broadband Fabry-Perot Antenna Loaded with an Energy-selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A Fabry-Perot (FP) resonator antenna loaded with an energy-selective surface (ESS) is designed to achieve broadband adaptive high-power microwave (HMP) protection. Firstly, a dual-band patch antenna is designed to achieve wideband performance. Then, an ESS loaded with center-symmetric Schottky diodes is designed to cover the patch antenna to achieve power protection functions. A complementary structure is used to achieve the positive phase gradient so as to increase the working bandwidth of the radiation patch. The performance of the whole design is finally simulated and analyzed with a bandwidth of 8-9GHz, which shows advantages over recent research with both FP structure and energy-selective function.

articleTitle: Dual-frequency Focusing Metasurface Based on Time Reversal in Complex Scattering Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper proposes a dual-frequency transmission metasurface based on time-reversal. The proposed metasurface consists of a designed dual-frequency unit that controls phase at 10 GHz and 17 GHz. Based on the time-reversal algorithm and metasurface, single-point electromagnetic focusing and multi-point electromagnetic focusing in free space and complex scattering environment is achieved simultaneously at 10 GHz and 17 GHz.

articleTitle: A Novel Metasurface Antenna with Reconfigurable Radiation and Scattering Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Reconfigurable radiation and scattering performance are desirable in many application scenarios. This paper proposes a novel metasurface antenna with reconfigurable radiation and scattering performance. This antenna is integrated with metasurface using a fragmented design strategy. Besides, varactors are incorporated in the metasurface antenna to tune the working frequency and the low radar-cross-section (RCS) band. It suggests that this antenna has reconfigurable resonating frequency with stable gain and reconfigurable scattering for both polarizations.

articleTitle: Design of Resonant SIW Antenna in UHF Band
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) resonant slot array antenna suitable for UHF band (902-928 MHz) RFID system is designed. The beam scanning is realized by using the Frequency-Hopping Spread Spectrum (FHSS) mode of RFID reader and the characteristics of SIW frequency scanning antenna. The simulated and measured results, based on the FR4 dielectric substrate, show that the antenna operates within the bandwidth of 902-928 MHz, with a beam scanning angle of 3 degrees. The design can improve the reliability and stability of RFID system by switching the beam with small amplitude.

articleTitle: Fast Total Radiated Power Tests Based on Igloo Sampling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: As an important performance metric of communication devices, the rapid and accurate measurement of total radiated power (TRP) has garnered increasing attention. Conventional TRP testing is typically conducted in an anechoic chamber using the equiangular sampling method. However, traditional equiangular sampling requires a large number of sampling points, resulting in significant time overhead for TRP testing. To address this issue, this paper proposes a fast TRP testing method based on igloo sampling. This method leverages the principles of igloo sampling, utilizing fewer sampling points to achieve the same TRP testing accuracy as traditional methods. With an elevation angular interval set to 15°, the proposed method can reduce sampling points by 30.83%.

articleTitle: Controllable Slotted SIW for Fixed-Frequency Planar Beam-Scanning Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper introduces a planar fixed-frequency beam-scanning antenna using a controllable slotted substrate integrated waveguide (SIW). The controllable SIW incorporates subwavelength slots and varactor diodes to enable dynamic adjustment of leaky-wave radiation characteristics. By electronically modifying the varactor diode capacitance, the antenna continuously steers the main beam at a fixed frequency. The antenna design features a simple structure and low profile, making it suitable for various radar and communication applications. Simulated results demonstrate the antenna's ability to achieve continuous beam-scanning at a fixed working frequency. The proposed antenna offers flexibility in beam direction adjustments independent of frequency changes, highlighting its practicality and adaptability in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Thyristor Conduction Angle Acquisition Based on Strong Tracking Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The frequency of thyristor failure in power electronic rectifier circuit is high, and most of them are collected through the on-state angle or on-state voltage drop to determine their fault status. Due to the difficulty of collecting the on-state voltage drop, the on-state angle is mostly collected in practical engineering. And the thyristor conduction angle acquisition is in the main circuit of power electronic equipment, its accuracy is vulnerable to electromagnetic, high-frequency noise and other interference. Therefore, it is important to improve the accuracy of on-state angle acquisition for thyristor fault determination. To address the accuracy of on-state angle acquisition, a strong tracking filter is introduced on the basis of Kalman Filter to solve the problem of unstable acquisition data and inability to track when sudden changes occur in the system. The pulse width is selected as the observation quantity for experiments, and the results show that the data processed with the strong tracking filter are closer to the real value. The algorithm can effectively improve the accuracy of data acquisition.

articleTitle: A Flexible Graphene-Based Antenna for RF Vortex Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Electromagnetic waves with orbital angular momentum (OAM) have garnered significant interest by reason of their potential in designing advanced communication systems. This paper reports on a specific design of a flexible graphene-based antenna for RF vortex wave generation. The antenna is composed of a ring-shaped resonator made of a graphene film with high conductivity deposited on a thin polydimethylsiloxane substrate. The graphene film is characterized by greater strength to repeated mechanical bending than metallic counterparts while providing good conductivity of the patch. We use the commercial ANSYS HFSS 3D electromagnetic solver to conduct full-wave numerical simulations of the antenna performances and radiation conditions, simulating the generation of vortex waves at different bending radii of the antenna. The mode purity is evaluated with the use of the spiral spectrum algorithm to reveal the stability of the vortex wave generation by the antenna in bent states. Several pilot samples of the antenna working in the RF band are fabricated and tested. Calculated together with empirical results demonstrate that the flexible antenna can stably generate vortex waves even subjected to either outward or inward bending. The proposed flexible graphene-based antenna has the potential for application in wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Model and Validation of Multi-point Near-field Cardiac Sensing System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Contactless cardiac sensing is drawing researchers’ attention because of its comfort, flexibility, and safety. However, as the far-field method may lose spatial resolution in the chest area and subtle heart dynamics. We developed the near-field cardiac sensing (NCS) method with high energy coupling and high spatial resolution characteristics. In this paper, we summarize NCS system and its near-field coupling electromagnetic (EM) numerical model. Then, the high spatial resolution multi-point NCS system is validated by EM simulation and experiments. Results show that NCS system can acquire the heartbeat dynamics with high spatial resolution, and it can detect heart chambers’ synchronization. So, NCS can be applied to noninvasive atrioventricular and interventricular dyssynchrony detection.

articleTitle: Inverse Design Based on Time Reversal Differentiation of FDTD
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a gradient calculation method based on the direct differential (DD) of the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) algorithm is presented. Based on the DD FDTD, we introduce the technical process for inverse design problems, including optimization parameters and objective functions. Compared with the adjoint variable method (AVM) and the automatic differentiation (AD), this method has the lowest computational cost. Meanwhile, we can define objective functions in both frequency- and time-domain, which makes the proposed method more flexible for broadband inverse design problems. We apply the proposed inverse design approach to design a terahertz wavelength division multiplexer (WDM).

articleTitle: A Low-profile Wideband Antenna Based on Decoupling Surface for Millimeter-wave Phased Array Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper presents a low-profile wideband antenna based on decoupling surface (DS) for millimeter-wave (MMW) Phased array (PAA) application. The proposed element is a coaxial feeding stacked patch antenna structure that consists of an L-shape coaxial probe, SIW cavity, slot layer, radiating patch, DS and defective ground structure (DGS). The DS and SIW cavity are used to reduce the coupling between antenna units to achieve wide-angle scanning. An 8×8 (64 elements) PAA is designed, and the simulation results are finished by the software CST2022, which reveals that the scanning range of the PAA achieves a 2D wide-angle scanning range of ±50°. The proposed antenna is promising for MMW PAA applications due to its compact design and ability to achieve wide-angle scanning in two dimensions.

articleTitle: Load Current Feedforward Fuzzy Adaptive PI Control Strategy for Single-phase Dual Active Bridge
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Single-phase Dual Active Bridge (DAB) is widely used in renewable energy systems due to its bidirectional energy flow and simple topology. The Dual Active Bridge (DAB) converter, has a symmetrical structure and commonly used phase shift control to realize bidirectional energy movement, and is suitable for high-power and high-frequency applications. The principle is simple, the control is convenient, and soft switching can be realized. DAB has low energy loss, and high efficiency. However, the existing single-phase DAB has some problems, such as slow dynamic response speed and large current harmonic distortion under nonlinear load. In order to solve these problems, a fuzzy adaptive PI control optimization strategy based on feed-forward load current is proposed in this paper, and a simulation model is established under bilateral double phase-shift modulation to verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Characterization and Analysis of Mutual Terrain-Scattered Interference Based on Different Jamming Signal Waveforms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Mutual terrain scattered interference (MTSI) has gradually emerged as an emerging threat, which leads to degraded imaging quality. In previous studies, the signal form of MTSI is similar to the synthetic aperture radar (SAR) signal, both being linear frequency modulation (LFM) signals. With the increase of satellite constellations in various applications, the potential of MTSI by different signal waveforms is also increasing. This paper investigates the characterization of MTSI based on different jamming signal waveforms. First, the MTSI scenario is constructed and the MTSI signal models based on three jamming waveforms, i.e., multiple-point frequency, LFM, and sinusoidal-modulated (SM), are derived. Then, the impact of different waveforms on MTSI is analyzed from multiple perspectives. The experimental results illustrate the relationship between various jamming waveforms and MTSI.

articleTitle: A Broadband Array Antenna Based on E-Shaped Folded Strip Elements for Millimeter-Wave N259/N260 Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A low-profile, wideband linearly-polarization array antenna based on broadband E-shaped folded strip elements is proposed. The antenna unit consists of a 2×2 array of E-shaped folded strip elements and four metalized through-holes. The microstrip line, located on the underside of an extremely thin dielectric substrate, utilizes a cross-shaped slot for its coupled feeding mechanism. This configuration markedly enhances the compatibility with circuits at millimeter-wave frequencies and also offers the advantage of a low-profile design. The simulated performance of the antenna module shows an impedance bandwidth covering 71%, extending from 21.43 GHz to 45 GHz, along with a peak gain of 5.925 dBi. Moreover, it maintains a cross-polarization discrimination level that is greater than 25 dB. To demonstrate the wideband and high-gain characteristics, a 2 × 2 array of linearly polarized antennas has been crafted, featuring a straightforward microstrip feed system and eliminating the necessity for an extra enclosure made of dielectric material. The simulated data reveal commendable characteristics regarding impedance correlation, gain, and the patterns of radiation, rendering the array well-suited for deployment in millimeter-wave applications designated as N259 and N260.

articleTitle: A Screen-Shooting Resilient Video Watermarking Algorithm Utilizing Information Membrane Overlay
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In video copyright protection, the prevention of unauthorized copying and infringement has become challenging, especially in scenarios involving reshooting. In this paper, a novel real-time video watermarking is proposed to resist screen-shooting attacks, which is agnostic to the host video demonstrating universality. In the proposed method, a template video called information membrane is adopted to enhance the privacy of the host video. The key to the embedding process is the generation of the information membrane, incorporating the watermark to be embedded, which is then overlaid onto the host video. Next, in the extraction process, the average and difference of chromatic values are calculated within frame groups, which remains stable before and after attacks, ensuring the effectiveness of the extraction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed algorithm exhibits strong robustness against screen-shooting attacks while maintaining visual quality.

articleTitle: A Polarization Reconfigurable Magneto-Electric Dipole Antenna for 2.2-2.7 GHz Band
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this article, a polarization-reconfigurable antenna based on magneto-electric (ME) dipoles is proposed. This antenna has three polarized states: linear polarization (LP), right-hand circular polarization (RHCP), and left-hand circular polarization (LHCP), which are mainly achieved through the cross strips with a bridge structure on top of the ME dipole. By changing the on/off states of diodes D1 and D2, the connections of the cross strips can be altered, thereby changing the surface current on the horizontal patches to achieve polarization reconfiguration. The proposed antenna is fed through a microstrip line and an H-shaped slot. The selected operating frequency band is 2.2-2.7 GHz. In all states, the bandwidth and 3-dB axial ratio bandwidth cover the operating band, and the gain is greater than 7 dBi within the operating band. This indicates that the antenna achieves polarization reconfiguration while maintaining good overall performance. Moreover, the reconfiguration method using diodes is easy to manufacture, making its application in wireless communication systems feasible.

articleTitle: Intra Beam Harmonic Suppression of 1-bit Spacetime-coding Metasurfaces for Wideband Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband communication method based on intra beam harmonic suppression for 1-bit space-timecoding metasurfaces is proposed. By setting space-time coding matrix as optimization object, differential evolution algorithm is utilized to optimize the directional angle of the first order harmonics, sidelobe level, sideband level and maximum useless harmonics level within 3dB beamwidth, which reduces the interference of useless harmonics to the wideband signal and improves the transmission quality of the wideband signal. Simulation results shows that the proposed method enables wideband signal transmission with a bandwidth 24 times the modulation frequency. It is equivalent to extending the maximum transmitted signal bandwidth from the fastest switching frequency of the diode to 1.2 times the fastest switching frequency of the diode.

articleTitle: Phase-shift Optimization and Trajectory Design for Wireless Communications aided by Double UAV-mounted Intelligent Reflecting Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: Intelligent reflecting surface(IRS) has been regarded as a revolutionary technology to achieve reconfigure communication system and achieve programmable wireless system. The researches on IRS mainly consider there only exist single hop reflection link in IRS assisted communication, the links between IRS are ignored. In this paper, we study a double UAV-mounted IRS assisted wireless communication system with the flight trajectory and the phase design at the two distributed IRSs. Moreover, the phase of UAV-mounted IRS is commonly shared by all the users, we analyze the phase optimization design of single users and multi-user scenarios to maximize the minimum average channel transmission rate. Simulation results have verified the reliability of project and effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Structured Meshing Approach for FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD) algorithm has found extensive applications in computational electromagnetics due to its simplicity, low computational cost, and divergence-free properties. However, the Yee grid-based FDTD algorithm may introduce inaccuracies when modeling irregular objects. Hence, this paper proposes a novel FDTD method based on two-dimensional triangular grids to address certain spatial modeling challenges. In the triangular FDTD algorithm, the spatial domain is initially discretized using triangular grids. Subsequently, starting from Maxwell's equations, updated equations for the electromagnetic and magnetic fields within the triangular grid are formulated. Concurrently, periodic boundary conditions for hexagonal simulation regions are established, and the spatial propagation patterns of the magnetic field are monitored. A comparative analysis is conducted between the temporal propagation patterns of Gaussian sources in triangular grids and Yee grids. Furthermore, a comparison is made regarding the resonant frequencies excited by Gaussian sources within Perfect Electric Conductor (PEC) boundary conditions to validate the feasibility of the triangular grid FDTD method.

articleTitle: A Highly Selective Frequency Selective Rasorber With Helical Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: The article introduces a unified surface selective for frequency, capable of absorbing and transmitting waves. Comprising two distinct strata, the structure features a lossy and a lossless layer, separated from one another by an air layer. The layer prone to loss is made up of a layered arrangement and a helical formation filled with resistance. Attaining the bandpass layer involves etching a square pattern of slits onto the copper surface. Results from the simulation indicate that between 2~7.5GHz, the reflection remains below -10dB, and the comparative bandwidth with a reflection coefficient under - 10dB reaches up to 116%. For frequencies where the transmission coefficient exceeds -3dB, the range spans from 3.8 to 4.3GHz, with the least insertion loss being 0.53dB at this frequency. In contrast to earlier frequency-selective absorbers, the suggested FSR exhibits reduced insertion loss.

articleTitle: A Graphical aid of the Smith Chart to Analyze the Linear to Circular Polarization Converter Based on Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A comprehensive approach to designing and analyzing the polarization converter based on metasurfaces is carried out by using full-wave simulation method, such as Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD) and Finite Element Method (FEM). While these approachs are highly accurate, but they lack intuitiveness. In this paper, a graphical method of the smith chart is proposed. The impedance, transmission and reflection coefficients of the metasurfaces can be displayed in the smith chart. The general variation law of them is directly seen in the smith chart, which is very intuitive for designers. Before structural design, an intuitive qualitative physical analysis is performed in the smith chart to obtain a good starting point and phase conditions required by each layer. Then, full-wave simulation method is used to verify the correctness of the smith chart analysis. The best illustration of this analytic and systematic method is probably the development of the metasurfaces-based linear to circular polarization converter from single-layer design to four-layer design in this paper. The proposed method may find important applications in modern metasurfaces-based devices, such as microwave absorber, antennas, radome and so on.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Quad-Band Qing-Shaped Patch Antenna Using CMA-Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel surrogate model based on characteristic mode analysis, applied in the design and optimization of a distinctive Qing-shaped patch antenna printed in LiShu format, a style of Chinese calligraphy. The optimized results demonstrate that the L-probe excited antenna achieves quad impedance bandwidths at 1.67, 2.13, 2.6, and 3.0 GHz, with an average broadside gain of 8 dBi. Through optimization, the overall patch size is determined to be 88 mm in width, 59 mm in length, and 16 mm in height.

articleTitle: Large-Scale Parallel Non-Conformal Complete Domain Decomposition for FE-BI-MLFMA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: We present a large-scale parallel complete domain decomposition method (CDDM) based hybrid finite element-boundary integral-multilevel fast multipole algorithm (FE-BI-MLFMA). The finite element subdomain interfaces employ second-order Robin transmission conditions, while the internal finite element parts and the external boundary integral surfaces use first-order Robin transmission conditions. The boundary integral equation part employs the discontinuous Galerkin domain decomposition technique. The entire finite element solution domain is divided into larger subdomains, each of which is assigned to an MPI process. Then the larger subdomains are evenly divided into smaller subdomains to achieve optimal computational efficiency. Two examples are provided to demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the large-scale parallel CDDM algorithm, including a large-scale antenna array.

articleTitle: Signal Integrity Analysis of Microwave Circuits Based on FETD Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: In this paper, a Finite-Element Time-Domain (FETD) method for electromagnetic fields is proposed to analyze signal integrity problems of microwave circuits. This method uses lumped ports to excite the microwave circuit, while electronic components in the circuit can be added to the simulation as lumped elements. The source in the simulation is modeled as an ideal current source. Using the proposed method, the voltage, current, and electric field at any location and time within the microwave circuit can be obtained. Post-processing the information at the ports allows the generation of eye diagrams. Compared to equivalent circuit simulation methods, the proposed method provides more accurate simulation results for the design of microwave circuits.

articleTitle: A Vacuum Sealed Rotary Joint with Low Loss for High Power Microwave Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: A vacuum sealed rotary joint with low transmission loss and high power capacity is presented in this paper. Rotary joint is an important part of the antenna array with stationary beam direction and high power capacity. An overmoded circular waveguide with TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf> as propagating mode, clasped each other by a bearing, is designed, fabricated, and tested. The measured optimum VSWR is 1.02 at central frequency 3.68 GHz. The cold measurements show that the transmission performance of the rotary joint are independent of the angle of rotation. A high power experiment is conducted and the developed rotary joint can sustain a peak input power of 3 GW.

articleTitle: Scheme of Low Transmitter Sampling Rate for New Generation Railway 5G Wideband Power Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)
abstract: To further ensure the safety of high-speed railway operation, improve the efficiency of high-speed railway transportation, a next generation 5G/6G system for railways is required. Compared with the existing band-limited digital predistortion method that reduces the wireless transmitter sampling rate by only suppressing the partial-band nonlinear distortion, the proposed digital predistortion scheme has the advantage of full-band linearization performance with the railway 5G/6G transmitter systems, which uses three branches with a relatively low sampling rate to respectively transmit the in-band, lower-band, and upper-band predistorted signals. The radio-frequency form of the full-band predistorted signals is restored in analog domain by using the analog in-band, lower-band, and upper-band predistorted signals. The condition for the low-pass filter, which is used to separate the in-band, lower-band, and upper-band predistorted signals from the full-band predistorted signal, is specifically explored.
